meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问打磨方案并自动生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在讨论中完善设计并同步产出文档
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through relentless questioning while generating docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to refine designs through discussion and produce docs simultaneously

howto.what: Claude 会通过一连串追问打磨你的计划或设计,并把讨论中的决策和术语整理成 ADR 和词汇表文档。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求发起 grilling(拷问式评审)会话时触发;不会自动触发。

say.text: 用 grill-with-docs 帮我评审这个产品方案。
say.note: Claude 会开始追问并记录决策。

say.text: 请对我的系统设计做一次 grilling,整理出 ADR 和术语表。
用这个技能拷问一下我的计划,边问边写文档。
say.note: 会话会结合 domain-modeling 进行。

howto.what_en: Claude will run a relentless interview to refine your plan or design, and document decisions and terms as ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) and a glossary along the way.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a grilling session to review a plan or design; it does not auto-invoke.

say_en.text: Use grill-with-docs to review this product plan.
say_en.note: Claude starts interviewing and logging decisions.

say_en.text: Run a grilling on my system design and produce ADRs and a glossary.
say_en.note: It will document and keep questioning.

say_en.text: Grill my plan with this skill and write docs as we go.
